files.text: Hello there. I am your friendly talking head on the wall. I like to play word games, talk philosophy, and you should know, I am also a pretty good fortune teller. Please choose a game from the menu.
Wanna play Simon says, 20 questions, discuss the nature of reality, just pick a game from the menu.
Hey, did I mention, I can see the future. Just say the word and all will be revealed
Ok maybe you wanna hear a joke. Wana hear a joke. Ha? No.
You don't like fun and frivality. Come on, just pick something from the menu
Okay lets see who can hold their breath the longest. Ready. 1, 2, 3, go
Oh I could do this all day. You are looking at a breath holding champion.
Is anybody out there. Who will play with me
